The '''Lurathi Guard''' was a military order that operated during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[700 BBY]], it merged with a number of other military orders, to form the [[Iotran Police Force]], a military force that was based on [[Iotra]]. Following the merger, the Guard continued to exist within the Police Force, as an organizational unit.
